digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 39
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Anvilworks opens its remote build cache
items.summary: Anvilworks has open-sourced its remote build cache server under the Apache 2.0 licence. The server speaks the standard remote execution cache protocol, so existing clients work unchanged.
items.whyItMatters: A hosted version stays available as a paid plan.

items.title: Skerry edge runtime 1.0 ships
items.summary: Skerry 1.0 is the first stable release of the edge runtime and starts functions in under a millisecond by snapshotting the initialised heap.
items.whyItMatters: Pricing and the free tier are unchanged.

items.title: Dockhaven registry ends mutable tags for official images
items.summary: Dockhaven will make tags on its official images immutable from 4 October, so a pull by tag always returns the same content.
items.whyItMatters: Pipelines that re-push a tag need to switch to unique tags before the change.

sources.title: Anvilworks opens its remote build cache
sources.summary: Anvilworks has open-sourced its remote build cache server under the Apache 2.0 licence. The server speaks the standard remote execution cache protocol, so existing clients work unchanged. A hosted version stays available as a paid plan.

sources.title: Skerry edge runtime 1.0 ships
sources.summary: Skerry 1.0 is the first stable release of the edge runtime. It starts functions in under a millisecond by snapshotting the initialised heap. Pricing and the free tier are unchanged.

sources.title: Dockhaven registry ends mutable tags for official images
sources.summary: Dockhaven will make tags on its official images immutable from 14 October. After that date a tag can no longer be pushed over an existing image, so a pull by tag always returns the same content. Pipelines that re-push a tag need to switch to unique tags before the change.
